intentionalBehavior.historicalBroadcastOptOut: Since documented0.50 ordinary individual deliveries intentionally ignore historical broadcast_preferences. Legacy opted_out terminal outcomes stay historical and are not requeued. This is not a new regression.
intentionalBehavior.taskOrdering: Task keyset pages are by stable ID, without global chronological ordering promise; reminders appear inside the app and emit no push while closed.
intentionalBehavior.replyTracking: Reading/unread receipts do not mark handled. Only explicit treatment or captured individual-reply watermark does. Broadcast deliveries intentionally do not handle requests.
intentionalBehavior.logoutAndQueuedCampaigns: Logout revokes interactive session but does not revoke already confirmed durable campaign approval; admin invalidation/MFA epoch change does pause it.

limitations: This scoped audit is not a claim of no bugs in all application code.
No new production transaction, real client account action, hosting command, remote mutation, browser, or full green-suite rerun was executed.
Existing native tests are synthetic local Chrome/SQL fixtures and do not attest physical phone background/foreground, real-device push reception or hosted throughput.
The2500-recipient test establishes bounded synthetic capture/delivery and exact-once local messages under its conditions, not load/concurrency capacity of shared hosting.
The52 general omissions remain omissions; SQL/Chrome/HTTPS native jobs independently show0 omissions.
Read depth is explicit: all principal backend modules were read fully; some supporting UI and test files only in excerpts or through named assertions/log successes.
No concrete residual question justified an isolated reproduction, so no new runtime test was executed.
